official_gis.provider: Purdue University campus GIS ArcGIS FeatureServer, BuildingShapesZip4 layer 0
official_gis.source_crs: EPSG:4326 response; original Purdue service uses EPSG:3857/102100 (as identified in prior project source docs)
official_gis.measurement_method: Official GIS ring transformed by project local geographic linear approximation, duplicate/collinear vertices simplified with iterative maximum local point-to-segment deviation tolerance 0.25m; horizontal origin is the original footprint bbox center.
official_gis.transform: X=(longitude - -86.9137) * 84810.6041653993 m/degree; Y=(latitude - 40.4274) * 111040.0 m/degree; Z up in meters; this is approximate project frame, not a surveyed CRS
official_gis.uncertainty: GIS service gives no survey tolerance/date; vertex accuracy and wall-to-outline association unverified; overhangs not represented.

architectural_references.published_facts: Purdue Archives indicates a 145,000-square-foot pharmacy facility completed/moved in 1970 and dedicated by name in 1985; Purdue pharmacy publication says six stories. GIS lists 8 level-coded values with roof 61m (vertical datum unclear), conflicting with published six-story description; visible massing modeled as 6 floors, 22m approximate. Official level-one plan supports circulation/lecture/reception/retail zones; schematic interior only.
architectural_references.google_maps_streetview: Not directly inspected in this subtask; image sources used where cited; model detail claims limited accordingly.

revision_sources.title: Purdue Events — Robert E. Heine Pharmacy Building
revision_sources.observation: Official place page includes an exterior image. Purdue’s building emergency plan describes Floors 1–5 above grade plus Floor G below and a basement; other Purdue publications call it six-story. The facade models five above-grade rows and a public pharmacy ground-floor cue; exact wall height remains GIS/photographic estimate.

revision_sources.title: Purdue Pharmacy building emergency plan
revision_sources.observation: Confirms offices, classrooms, student/research labs, Pharmacy Stores, a licensed pharmacy, five above-grade floors, lower Floor G, and basement. Ground-floor counter/shelf details are schematic.

revision_sources.title: Wikimedia Commons — Robert E. Heine Pharmacy Building exterior photograph
revision_sources.observation: Exterior photo used to study the tall stone entrance arcade; architectural interpretation is approximate.

validation.reopen_check: Saved, reopened from the saved .blend in Blender 5.2.3, and rerendered from that reopened scene; stable collection, placement_origin_xy_m, geometry, materials and source-file hash checked.

notes: Added a narrow vertical glazed circulation bay and pale stone pilaster cadence; model shows five above-grade public levels while the six-floor campus sources appear to include one lower level. The GIS extrusion/roof field remains uncertain.
Reworked the public pharmacy ground-floor entry with a five-bay stone arcade, retail counter/shelf cues, enlarged PURDUE PHARMACY sign, and a compact estimated mechanical penthouse.
Added schematic lab/office activity behind the frontage glazing; it does not assert room layouts.

Added a warm schematic vestibule cue behind the glazed entry, plus a short entry walk and paired low planters. Interior room layout, site furniture, and planting placement are interpretive, not survey-derived.
